commentary.text: 90+9' Jose Munuera is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Dani Raba (Valencia).
90+7' Javier Bonar will be replaced by Aleksa Puric (Atl. Madrid).
90+4' The corner kick from Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
90+3' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jose Munuera no option but to blow his whistle.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
89' Valencia control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
82' A substitution has been made. Renzo Saravia is replaced by Dani Raba (Valencia).
82' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Jose Munuera signals that the goal stands! The Atl. Madrid players celebrate.
82' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Jose Munuera is going to take a look using VAR.
82' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Miguel Cubo (Atl. Madrid) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
82' 0 - 2 Goal! Antoine Griezmann provides Miguel Cubo (Atl. Madrid) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort inside the right post. 0:2.
81' Javier Bonar (Atl. Madrid) and Koke perform a quick tiki-taka to get past two defenders and then continue the move along the side line.
79' The corner is swung in but Atl. Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
78' The Atl. Madrid players are exchanging some short passes.
77' Juan Musso (Atl. Madrid) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

74' 0 - 1 Goal! Great link up play between Iker Luque (Atl. Madrid) and Obed Vargas gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom left corner. 0:1.
73' Substitution. Jose Gaya makes his way off the pitch and Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) comes on as his replacement.
73' It will be a substitution. Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) is ready to enter the pitch as Largie Ramazani walks off.
73' Diego Simeone prepares a substitution. Rodrigo Mendoza is replaced by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid).
73' Substitution. Koke (Atl. Madrid) has come on for Thiago Almada.
69' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
68' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Stole Dimitrievski.
67' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) picks up a yellow card.
65' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Valencia.
63' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Rayane Belaid will be replaced by Iker Luque (Atl. Madrid).

62' The referee points to the corner flag and Valencia will take a corner.
61' Jose Munuera shows a yellow card to Obed Vargas (Atl. Madrid) for a tough tackle.
59' Here is a change. Luis Rioja is going off and Carlos Corberan gives the last tactical orders to Diego Lopez (Valencia).
59' The manager makes a subsitution with Hugo Duro (Valencia) coming on for Filip Ugrinic.
58' The ball is out of play and Atl. Madrid manage to earn a corner.
57' The ball is cleared after Luis Rioja (Valencia) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is behind the touchline and Atl. Madrid will take a throw-in.
56' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atl. Madrid comes to nothing.
56' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 5:11.
55' The Atl. Madrid players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
52' The foul by Rodrigo Mendoza (Atl. Madrid) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jose Munuera.
50' Valencia are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
50' Rodrigo Mendoza (Atl. Madrid) tries to find Nahuel Molina, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
49' Poor challenge! Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) is penalised for tripping and Jose Munuera blows his whistle.
48' Renzo Saravia (Valencia) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
47' Valencia keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
47' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) dribbles into the box, but Stole Dimitrievski is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
46' Neat passing move from Atl. Madrid in order to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) is unable to get the free-kick over the defensive wall from mid-range.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' A pass by Julio Diaz (Atl. Madrid) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
42' Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.

40' The Valencia players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.

39' POST! Largie Ramazani (Valencia) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the left post. What a strike that was! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
38' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atl. Madrid.

35' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) misses a golden opportunity to score from inside the six-yard box after firing the ball over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
35' Atl. Madrid earn a corner.
29' Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Munuera had an easy-decision to make.
28' Atl. Madrid are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
26' Valencia seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
24' A cross into the box from Javi Guerra (Valencia) is cleared.
21' Atl. Madrid are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence. The ball has crossed the sideline. Atl. Madrid are taking a throw-in.
20' The ball possession is 58:42.
18' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) gets into a shooting position! What a long-range cannonball of a shot! His nice effort, however, only crashes against the left post. Aim better, sir.
17' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Atl. Madrid.
13' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
13' The attendance for today's match is 45889.

11' Atl. Madrid exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely. The ball is out of play. Valencia will take a throw-in.

9' The game is pretty dull as Valencia are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball. It's a throw-in for Valencia.
7' Valencia enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
5' Pepelu (Valencia) and Cesar Tarrega matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
4' Atl. Madrid control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
2' The Valencia players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Great teamplay by Valencia as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
